description: ONE Rust source of truth for the daemon's attachment admission limits: canonical is exactly faktor_provider::AttachmentLimits::for_model(MAX_ATTACHMENT_UPLOAD_BYTES, api::MAX_BODY_BYTES, MAX_MODEL_IMAGE_BYTES, true, MAX_MODEL_DOCUMENT_BYTES) for the default provider profile; emergencyCeiling is the conservative fallback the IDEs keep for the window before the model catalog is read. Checked by crates/server/src/native/models.rs and consumed by apps/vscode and apps/jetbrains tests.
